subject: SIG questionnaire initiation and SOC 2 clarifications for ZenHealth
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@zenhealth.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SIG questionnaire initiation and SOC 2 clarifications

Hi Emily / Samir,

Thanks again for the time this morning — good discussion and helpful context on ZenHealth's production use case. Quick recap + proposed next steps on the security/compliance side so we can keep things moving toward a pilot: 

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II controls for our hosted service and can provide a redacted attestation for review.
- GDPR / HIPAA: We support GDPR controls. For HIPAA / PHI workloads we typically recommend either Dedicated or Private deployments and are able to execute a BAA; I can loop in legal if ZenHealth will need a BAA.
- Vendor questionnaire: happy to complete your SIG / CAIQ or your custom vendor questionnaire. To accelerate, I'm attaching a short package with a prefilled SIG/CAIQ export and a high-level SOC 2 summary.

Action items / asks for ZenHealth:
1) Please confirm which questionnaire you want us to prioritize (SIG vs CAIQ vs your custom doc).
2) Can you confirm whether PHI/PII will be sent to Redwood during the pilot and the required data residency (US/EU)?
3) Target timeline — does 2026-04-22 for a completed SIG work for your security team?

I've attached "redwood-sig-request.zip" (contains prefilled SIG/CAIQ & SOC 2 summary) and included Marissa (CS) and Dev (Security) on CC to help move this forward. If it's helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with Dev to walk through any technical questions.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@zenhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@zenhealth.com>, security@zenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SIG questionnaire initiation and SOC 2 clarifications

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the recap and the attachment — appreciated. A few clarifying questions from our security team before we kick off the full SIG: 

1) BAA: Can Redwood sign a BAA for the hosted offering, or is that limited to Dedicated/Private deployments? We expect some PHI in the pilot and need to confirm contractual support.
2) SOC 2 report: Is the most recent SOC 2 Type II report available now, or will there be a short wait? Our reviewers prefer an attestation dated within the last 12 months.
3) Encryption / key management: Can you confirm whether encryption at rest uses customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or service-managed keys for the hosted product?
4) Data residency: For now ZenHealth will keep data in the US, but curious whether Redwood can guarantee region residency for EU customers (long-term).

We have a custom vendor questionnaire (attached as "zenhealth-vendor-q-v2.docx"); if it's easier, please complete the CAIQ you sent and we'll map fields. Timeline: two weeks for the SIG is reasonable on our side (target 2026-04-29) if we can get the initial responses this week.

Looping in security@zenhealth.com for any follow-up.

Thanks — Emily

--
Emily Chen
Director of Product, ZenHealth
emily.chen@zenhealth.com | (617) 555-0987

Attachments: zenhealth-vendor-q-v2.docx (custom questionnaire)

Hi Emily / Samir,

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- BAA: We can execute a BAA, including for hosted customers, though some hosted customers prefer Dedicated/Private for additional isolation. I'll flag Legal and include a redline-ready template if you confirm ZenHealth will need a BAA.
- SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II attestation is available (audit period ending 2025-12-31). I'm attaching a one-page summary now and can provide the full report under an NDA / redaction request.
- Encryption / KMS: For Redwood's hosted API we use service-managed KMS by default; we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) on Dedicated and Private deployments. We can note this on the SIG answers.
- Data residency: We support region pinning for Dedicated and Private; hosted customers can be routed to region-specific endpoints but Dedicated/Private provide stronger residency guarantees.

A few clarifying asks so we can fill out the SIG/CAIQ accurately: 
1) Please confirm whether PHI/PII will be sent in the pilot and an example of the data flow (upload vs API request).
2) Desired retention period for logs and outputs (e.g., 30/90/365 days).
3) Are you aiming for hosted or Dedicated for the pilot? If you plan Dedicated, we'll provide more detailed infrastructure diagrams.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll have Dev Patel (security engineering) complete the technical sections of the CAIQ and our compliance team will provide SOC 2 summary.
- If you prefer your custom questionnaire, please confirm and we'll prioritize mapping fields (CAIQ -> your doc).
- Target: we'll aim to send an initial CAIQ response and SOC summary by 2026-04-22 (one week) to meet your two-week timeline.

If that timeline or any of the answers above need adjustments, let me know — happy to jump on a short call with Dev / Marissa.

Best,
Jordan
